# Nouvelle Workz Pte. Ltd. - Company Information & Service Data

> Structured reference for Nouvelle Workz Pte. Ltd., a premier direct renovation
> contractor and commercial fit-out specialist operating in Singapore. All figures are 2026 reference rates.

## 1. Brand Entity & Trust Signals
- Company Name: Nouvelle Workz Pte. Ltd.
- Business Model: Direct Builder / Direct Renovation Contractor (zero interior design firm markups, saving clients 15%–30%)
- Founder / Managing Director: James Liang (9+ years experience in interior design, carpentry, and construction)
- Service Area: Singapore (Islandwide)
- Registered Address: 21 Bukit Batok Crescent, #09-73, WCEGA Tower, Singapore 658065
- WhatsApp / Phone: +65 9109 8102
- Email: nouvelleworkz@gmail.com
- Official Website: https://nouvelleworkz.com/
- Licences & Statutory Certifications:
  - HDB Licensed Renovation Contractor (Licence No. HB-075810E)
  - BCA Registered Contractor (General Building & Demolition works)
  - bizSAFE Level 3 Certified (Approved for Grade A commercial buildings, shopping malls & industrial parks)
- Customer Satisfaction: 5.0-star rating across verified Google Reviews (78+ reviews)

## 2. Project Scope & Minimum Spend Policy (SGD $3,000)
Nouvelle Workz specializes exclusively in comprehensive transformations, room overhauls, and commercial fit-outs.
- Minimum Project Commitment: SGD $3,000 per project.
- Exclusions: Nouvelle Workz DOES NOT provide standalone ad-hoc handyman repairs, emergency plumbing fixes (e.g. choked pipes, leaking taps), single-socket electrical replacements, or minor single-tile patch-ups.
- All specialist trades are delivered as part of integrated renovation or dedicated makeover packages.

## 3. Commercial Renovation & Reinstatement Services
Nouvelle Workz is a trusted commercial contractor for office tenancies, shopping mall retail units, F&B establishments, and industrial warehouses in Singapore.

- Office & Commercial Reinstatement:
  - Core Value Proposition: 100% Landlord Security Deposit Return Guarantee.
  - Turnaround: Free joint site inspection and itemized quotation delivered within 24 to 48 hours.
  - Scope: Complete lease-end restoration to original handover condition (drywall partition hacking, ceiling grid restoration, vinyl/carpet glue grinding, DB box reinstatement, SCDF fire safety sprinkler & detector realignment, landlord white repainting).
  - Approvals: MCST fit-out deposits, PE endorsements, and SCDF FSSD submissions handled end-to-end.
- Commercial Office Fit-Out & Renovation:
  - Full-suite office interior design and build, acoustic glass meeting rooms, executive carpentry, raised flooring, and M&E rewiring.
- Retail & Salon Renovation:
  - High-traffic commercial finishes, custom display gondolas, feature lighting, and mall management compliance.
- F&B & Restaurant Renovation:
  - SFA licensing compliance, kitchen exhaust ducting, commercial grease trap installations, and waterproof flooring.
- Factory & Industrial Renovation:
  - JTC guidelines compliance, B1/B2 industrial fit-outs, heavy-duty epoxy/PU floor coatings, and high-ceiling partition walls.

## 4. Residential Renovation Packages
- BTO Renovation Packages: Full-flat turnkey solutions for 3-Room, 4-Room, and 5-Room flats.
- HDB Resale Renovation: Complete hacking, waterproofing, tiling, rewiring, and custom built-in cabinetry.
- Condominium & Landed Property Works: Luxury finishes, marble/sintered stone integration, structural alterations with PE approval.
- Partial Makeover Packages: Dedicated Kitchen & 2-Bathroom overhauls (typically SGD $8,000 - $18,000).

## 5. 16 In-House Specialist Trades (Factory Direct Pricing)
1. Custom Carpentry: In-house workshop fabrication using solid plywood, Blum soft-close hardware, and HPL laminates ($120 - $280 per foot run).
2. Tiling & Masonry: HDB-approved floor and wall tiling, screeding, and waterproofing.
3. Plumbing & Sanitary: Concealed piping, toilet fixture installations for complete bathroom overhauls.
4. Electrical & M&E: Licensed Electrical Worker (LEW) certified rewiring, DB box upgrades, track lighting.
5. Ceiling & Partition: Acoustic drywall partitions, suspended false ceilings, and cove lightings.
6. Wall Plastering: Smooth skimming and plastering for resale and BTO walls.
7. Painting & Coating: Whole-house premium interior/exterior painting.
8. Epoxy Grouting: Stain-proof and mildew-resistant epoxy grout for wet areas.
9. Metallic Epoxy Flooring: Seamless designer epoxy floors for homes and commercial spaces.
10. SPC Vinyl Flooring: Heavy-duty 5mm waterproof click-lock vinyl flooring.
11. Decorative Paint & Microcement: Limewash, textured stucco, and microcement feature walls.
12. Decorative Wall Panels: Acoustic fluted panels and architectural cladding.
13. Sintered Stone Surfaces: Seamless kitchen islands, feature walls, and vanity counters.
14. Custom Table Tops: Quartz, sintered stone, and solid surface countertop fabrication.
15. Custom Mirrors & Glass: Fluted glass doors, shower screens, and LED vanity mirrors.
16. Demolition & Hacking: BCA-compliant hacking, structural opening, and debris haulage.
